summary: FX Inline has strong inline conversion technology but almost no monetization infrastructure or traction. The fastest path to first revenue is a manual B2B pilot for cross-border price localization, with affiliate content and a later consumer premium tier as secondary tracks.

recommended_focus.title: Sell one manual B2B pilot for cross-border price localization
recommended_focus.why: The repo already contains the hard technical asset: robust currency detection plus inline rendering. A single pilot can produce revenue faster than waiting for consumer install scale.
recommended_focus.smallest_viable_test: Rebuild the website around one paid pilot offer, show a real before-after demo, and send targeted outreach to cross-border ecommerce stores or travel publishers.

evidence: Structured Amazon and sibling price decorators

ranked_opportunities.title: Manual B2B pilot or lightweight license for cross-border price localization
ranked_opportunities.rationale: One buyer can validate willingness to pay faster than consumer scale. The parser plus inline renderer already form a credible demo.
ranked_opportunities.smallest_test: Offer a 2-week pilot for one merchant or publisher page set.

ranked_opportunities.title: Affiliate content around foreign shopping, travel, and money movement
ranked_opportunities.rationale: The product naturally sits before transfer or booking decisions, so referral economics can work without building billing.
ranked_opportunities.smallest_test: Publish 3 use-case pages and test one Wise or travel referral CTA.

ranked_opportunities.title: Paid consumer extension upgrade
ranked_opportunities.rationale: Consumer monetization is viable, but not before installs and activation improve.
ranked_opportunities.smallest_test: Gate multi-currency compare mode, presets, and premium rate refresh behind a one-time license.

ranked_opportunities.title: Open-core package plus paid support and custom parser packs
ranked_opportunities.rationale: The package can become a lead source and proof asset once published.
ranked_opportunities.smallest_test: Publish to npm and add a commercial support/contact CTA.

ranked_opportunities.title: Agency and publisher partnerships
ranked_opportunities.rationale: Partnerships can deliver both buyers and distribution faster than broad social reach.
ranked_opportunities.smallest_test: Pitch 10 Shopify agencies or travel publishers with a revenue-share or setup-fee offer.

ranked_opportunities.title: Embeddable snippet or hosted conversion API
ranked_opportunities.rationale: There is real B2B demand for currency tooling, but packaging, support, and billing are still missing.
ranked_opportunities.smallest_test: Sell a script-based implementation before building a dashboard.

assumptions: No deployed production website URL or analytics stack was found in the repo.
Chrome listing metadata was validated via Extpose because the direct Chrome Web Store page was not reliably retrievable during research.
Public Firefox snippets showed inconsistent version metadata across locales, so version observations are treated as a trust warning rather than authoritative release history.
No live npm listing was found for @fx-inline/currency-detection.
risks: Consumer premium monetization will likely fail if attempted before installs and activation improve.
Affiliate revenue will remain negligible without owned traffic or audience capture.
A public package launch without a licensing or support plan could create maintenance burden without monetization.
Broad positioning as a generic currency converter will be hard to defend against larger incumbents.
